candidates.title: SolidCraft: open-source parametric 3D CAD in Rust with a built-in MCP server so AI agents can model
candidates.summary: Sketch-constrain-extrude CAD with a feature timeline that rebuilds when a parameter changes; runs on desktop or in the browser, and agents can drive it through MCP.
candidates.notes: README fetched; Pi 4 case demo. Caveat: young project; agent-modeling quality unverified.

candidates.title: Plimsoll: sandbox that stamps every agent-code run with its isolation strength and refuses weaker sandboxes
candidates.summary: Self-hosted Go sandbox; each result carries a tier (process, container, kernel, vm) and a request can set a minimum tier, otherwise nothing runs.
candidates.notes: Low HN signal but strong fit; fits recent agent-safety news theme.

candidates.title: Atticus: hold-to-talk voice assistant for macOS running on an existing Claude plan via Claude Code
candidates.summary: Open-source Swift app; simple asks skip the AI (app opens in 0.08 s), learned actions replay free, README claims ~0.18 cent per ask.
candidates.notes: Costs are the author's claim. Similar-category Mac tool (SCM) covered 10-07 but different function.

candidates.title: BetterWispr: free open-source dictation for Mac with local speech models
candidates.summary: Transcribes on-device (nine models incl. Apple speech, Parakeet, Whisper), strips ums and false starts, per-app writing style; no account.
candidates.notes: Homepage fetched; GitHub link on site, repo URL not independently fetched. Crowded category.

candidates.title: Parsimony: open benchmark of how much code each AI coding agent adds
candidates.summary: Public leaderboard ranking coding agents by how little code they change to solve tasks.
candidates.notes: Page fetched but methodology not read; verify before writing.

candidates.title: PDF TO MP3: turn PDFs into audiobooks using your existing Codex or Claude subscription via MCP
candidates.summary: Connects an AI chat to a converter over MCP; subscription handles document processing, user supplies a speech key billed by Google or OpenAI.
candidates.notes: Commercial service with pricing page; borderline paid placement risk.

candidates.title: Running RAG with a small language model entirely in the browser
